senses.gloss:
जयन्तः —1 N. of the son of Indra; पौलोमीसंभवेनेव जयन्तेन
 पुरन्दरः V. 5. 14; Ś. 7. 2; R. 3. 23, 6. 78.
—2 N. of Śiva.
—3 The moon.
—4 N. of Viṣṇu.
—5 A name assumed by Bhīma at the court of Virāṭa.

जयन्तः + .{@-ती@}
—1 A flag or banner.
—2 N. of the daughter of Indra.
—3 N. of Durgā.
—4 Blades of barley planted at the commencement of the Dasarā and gathered at its close.
—5 The rising of the asterism Rohiṇī at midnight on the eighth day of
 the dark half of Śrāvaṇa i. e. on the birth day of Kṛṣṇa.
.━{@Comp.@}: जयन्तपत्रम्, जयन्तसप्तमी

जयन्तिः (-न्ती)
 A synonym of the balance-post; तुलादण्डो जयन्ती च फलकाः
 पर्यायवाचकाः Māna. 16. 48.

जयन्तः + -पत्रम् (in law)
—1 the written award of the judge in favour of either party.
—2 the label on the fore-head of a horse turned-loose for the Aśvamedha sacrifice.
जयन्तः + -सप्तमी the Seventh day in the bright half of Māgha.

जयन्तिः (-न्ती)
 A synonym of the balance-post; तुलादण्डो जयन्ती च फलकाः
 पर्यायवाचकाः Māna. 16. 48.

जयद्रथः A king of the Sindhu district and brother-in-law of Duryodhana,
 having married Duhśalā, daughter of Dhṛtarāṣṭra. [Once while out
 on hunting, he chanced to see Draupadī in the forest, and asked of her
 food for himself and his retinue. Draupadī, by virtue of her magical
 sthālī, was able to supply him with materials sufficient for their break-fast.
 Jayadratha was so much struck with this act, as well as her personal charms,
 that he asked her to elope with him. She, of course, indignantly refused,
 but he succeeded in carrying her off, as her husbands were out on hunting.
 When they returned they pursued and captured the ravisher and released
 Draupadī; and he himself was allowed to go after having been subjected
 to many humiliations. He took a leading part in compassing the death of
 Abhimanyu, and met his doom at the hands of Arjuna in the great war.]

जया f. The name of a magical lore (often mentioned with विजया)
 taught by Viśvāmitra to Rāma, विद्यामथैनं विजयां जयां च Bk. 2. 21.

जयः + .{@-या@}
—1 N. of Durgā.
—2 N. of an attendant of the goddess Durgā.
—3 A kind of banner.
—4 The third, eighth or thirteenth lunar days of any of the two lunar fortnights.
.━{@Comp.@}: जयाजयौ, जयावह, जयाशिस्, जयोदधुर, जयकुञ्जरः, जयकोलाहलः, जयगत,^1 जयघोषः, जयघोषणम्, जयघोषणा, जयढक्का, जयदम्, जयदत्तः, जयदेवः, जयपत्रम्, जयपालः, जयपुत्रकः, जयमङ्गलः, जययज्ञः, जयलक्ष्मीः, जयश्रीः, जयलेखम्, जयवाहिनी, जयशब्दः, जयशृङ्गम्, जयस्तम्भः, जयस्थलम्, जयस्वामिन्
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.

जाया A wife. (The word is thus derived━ पतिर्भार्यां संप्रविश्य
 गर्भो भूत्वेह जायते । जायायास्तद्धिः जायात्वं यदस्यां जायते पुनः ॥
 Ms. 9. 8; see also Malli. on R. 2. 1.) As last member of Bah. comp. जाया
 is changed to जानि; सीताजानिः ‘one who has Sītā for his wife’; so
 युवजानिः, वामार्धजानिः
.━{@Comp.@}: जायानुजीविन्, जायाघ्नः, जायापती

जय्य a. [जि-यत्] Conquerable, vulnerable, that can be conquered
 (opp. जेय).
जायकम् A kind of yellow fragrant wood.

जायन्तेयः The son of Jayantī; जायन्तेयान् मुनीन् प्रीतः सोपाध्यायो
 ह्यपूजयत् Bhāg. 11. 5. 43.

जाया + -अनुजीविन् m., {@-आजीवः@}
—1 an actor, a dancer.
—2 the husband of a harlot.
—3 a needy man, pauper.
—4 a kind of crane (बक).

जाया + -घ्नः
—1 a murderer of his wife.
—2 a mole or mark on the body indicative of the death of oneʼs wife.

जाया + -पती (dual) husband and wife. (The other forms of the comp. are
 दम्पती and जम्पती q. v.)

जायिन् a. (-नी f.)
 [जि-णिनि] Conquering, subduing. ━m. The burden
 of a song (in music).

जयिन् a. [जि शीलार्थे इनि]
—1 Conquering, vanquishing; विरूपाक्षस्य जयिनीस्ताः स्तुवे वामलोचनाः Vb. 1. 2.
—2 Successful, winning a law-suit, Y. 2. 79.
—3 Fascinating, captivating, subduing the heart; जगति जयिनस्ते ते
 भावा नवेन्दुकलादयः Māl. 1. 36. ━m. A victor, a conqueror; पौरस्त्यानेवमाक्रामंस्तांस्ताञ्जनपदाञ्जयी R. 4. 34.
जायु a. Victorious.

जयः [जि भावे अच्]
—1 Conquest, triumph, victory, success, winning (in battle, game or a
 law-suit); सप्त वित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः क्रयो जयः Mb. 10. 115.
—2 Restraint, curbing, conquest as in इन्द्रियजय.
—3 N. of the sun.
—4 N. of Jayanta, son of Indra; जगृहे च धनुर्धाता मुसलं तु जयस्तया
 Mb. 1. 227. 34.
—5 N. of Yudhiṣṭhira, the first Pāṇḍava prince.
—6 N. of an attendant of Viṣṇu.
—7 An epithet of Arjuna; संस्मरन् भ्रातरं जयम् Mb. 3. 158. 2.
—8 N. of the Mahābhārata; देवीं सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्
 Mb. 1. 1. 1; Bhāg. 1. 2. 4;
—9 The heroic sentiment; सहजेतरौ जयशमौ दधती Ki. 6. 22.
—10 Words of victory; जयेन वर्धयित्वा च मारीचप्रमुखास्ततः Rām. 7. 23. 3.
जयः + -अजयौ Victory and defeat; सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ Bg. 2. 38.
जयः + -आवह a. conferring victory.

जयः + -आशिस् f.
—1 a prayer for victory.
—2 congratulations after victory; a cheer
[]
 of victory.
जयः + -उदधुर a. exulting in victory.
जयः + -कुञ्जरः a victorious elephant; आक्षिप्तो जयकुञ्जरेण Ratn. 4. 12.

जयः + -कोलाहलः
—1 a shout of victory.
—2 a kind of game with dice.

जयः + -गत^1 a. Conquering, victorious; उक्तविपरीतलक्षणसंपन्नो
 जयगतो विनिर्दिष्टः Bṛ. S. 17. 10.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.
जयः + -घोषः, -घोषणम्, -घोषणा a proclamation of victory.
जयः + -घोषः, -घोषणम्, -घोषणा a proclamation of victory.
जयः + -घोषः, -घोषणम्, -घोषणा a proclamation of victory.
जयः + -ढक्का a kind of drum beaten as a sign of victory.
जयः + -दम् A height which is 1½ of the breadth; Māna. 35. 22-26.
जयः + -दत्तः N. of Jayanta, Indraʼs son.

जयः + -देवः N. of the author of Gītagovinda; यावच्छृङ्गारसारस्वतमिह
 जयदेवस्य विष्वग्वचांसि Gīt. last stanza.
जयः + -पत्रम् a record of victory.

जयः + -पालः
—1 a king.
—2 an epithet of Brahmā.
—3 an epithet of Viṣṇu.
जयः + -पुत्रकः a kind of dice.

जयः + -मङ्गलः
—1 a royal elephant.
—2 a remedy for fever.

जयः + -मङ्गलः + .({@-लम्@}) a cheer of victory; ततो ऽब्धिवीचिनिर्घोषैरुद्गीतजयमङ्गलः
 Rāj. T. 4. 158.
जयः + -यज्ञः the अश्वमेध sacrifice

जयः + -लक्ष्मीः, -श्रीः the goddess of victory; जयलक्ष्म्या बबन्धास्थां
 श्वश्रूः Rāj. T. 5. 246; बभार यद्भुजस्तम्भो जयश्रीसालभञ्जिकाम्
 ibid. 2. 64; Ku. 2. 52.

जयः + -लक्ष्मीः, -श्रीः the goddess of victory; जयलक्ष्म्या बबन्धास्थां
 श्वश्रूः Rāj. T. 5. 246; बभार यद्भुजस्तम्भो जयश्रीसालभञ्जिकाम्
 ibid. 2. 64; Ku. 2. 52.
जयः + -लेखम् record of victory; … … रतिजयलेखम् Gīt. 8. 3.
जयः + -वाहिनी an epithet of Śachī.

जयः + -शब्दः
—1 a shout of victory.
—2 the exclamation ‘jaya’ (hail! glory!) uttered by bards &c.
जयः + -शृङ्गम् a horn blown to announce a victory.
जयः + -स्थलम् N. of a village, ibid. 5. 121.
जयः + -स्वामिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
जयक a. Victorious.
जयत्सेनः A name assumed by Nakula while living at Virāṭa King.
जयद्वलः A name assumed by Sahadeva.

जयनम् [जि करणे ल्युट्] Conquering, subduing.
—2 Armour for cavalry, elephants &c.
.━{@Comp.@}: जयनयुज्

जयनम् + -युज्
—1 caparisoned.
—2 victorious.
